sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Check current segmentation
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']

# Count green cells in grid area
green_count = 0
gray_count = 0
white_count = 0
for node in nodes:
    boundary = node['boundary']
    if boundary:
        min_row = min(p[0] for p in boundary)
        min_col = min(p[1] for p in boundary)
        if 47 <= min_row <= 63 and 22 <= min_col <= 39:
            if node['color'] == 'N':
                green_count += 1
            elif node['color'] == 'g':
                gray_count += 1
            elif node['color'] == 'W':
                white_count += 1

print(f"Green cells: {green_count}, Gray cells: {gray_count}, White cells: {white_count}")

# Check top bar elements
print("\n=== Top bar elements ===")
for node in nodes:
    if node['color'] in ['S', 'b', 'B']:  # sky blue, blue, black
        boundary = node['boundary']
        if boundary:
            min_row = min(p[0] for p in boundary)
            min_col = min(p[1] for p in boundary)
            if 10 <= min_row <= 25 and 20 <= min_col <= 45:
                print(f"  ID {node['id']}: color={node['color']}, pixels={node['pixels']}, boundary={boundary[:4]}...")

# Try clicking the blue square on the left of the top bar
# From the image, it's around row 15-17, col 25-27
action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 16, 'col': 26}])

print(f"\nLevel completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
print(f"Game over: {last_action_result.get('game_over')}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
